applicableClauses.note: A tablet that no longer powers on during normal use is a manufacturing defect covered by this clause.
24-month warranty period in all regions. warranty_lookup reports the claim date within standard coverage.
The battery period does not apply; the reported failure is not a battery fault.
No liquid contact reported or visible.

structuredOutput.summary: Covered: a spontaneous power failure is a manufacturing defect under POL-5, and the claim is within the 24-month warranty period of POL-1 as computed by warranty_lookup. The liquid-damage exclusion (POL-3) does not apply.
